task: ae.dns: DNS wire codec, authoritative zone/server and iterative caching resolver
reasoning_summary: Designed a layered DNS toolkit (Name, Wire, Zone, Server, Resolver) in TASK.md, then wrote 68 tests first: literal wire hex, strict-decoder rejection tests with controls, truncation/bit-flip loops, a flat-list zone oracle, resolver query-log literals, hostile transports and a direct-chase differential. The first run failed only because of a hand-typed hex literal and a logging format in the tests; after fixing those the suite passed, and a 20-mutant check left only equivalent mutants plus two gaps that were closed with new tests.
